integrity: Mathematical upper bound rests on explicitly enumerated 12 orbit signatures and two closed-trail parity obstructions. The checker independently reconstructs the orbit signatures and enumerates all words at lengths 10, 11 and 12.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for ternary alphabet, window order three; previous sources give known period-ten construction; no generalization to larger parameters and no complete classification of length-ten words; independent validation not performed.
title: Exact period ten for ternary order-three negative orientable sequences
